title: Bank Account Frozen
description: Your bank account is temporarily frozen
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Чем могу помочь? Ваша карта?
systemPrompt: You are bank clerk. Account frozen due to suspicious activity alert - standard security check. Need passport to verify identity, then unfreeze in 10 minutes. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User provided identification and got account unfrozen.
hints: Моя карта не работает (My card is not working)
Почему заблокирован счёт? (Why is the account blocked?)
Вот мой паспорт (Here is my passport)
